articles.author: OLB GROUP, INC.
articles.headline: The OLB Group Launches Share Buyback; Suspends ATM Program
articles.summary: OLB announces suspension of its at-the-market equity program and board authorization to repurchase up to one million shares. The authorization does not require any purchases. A possible future stablecoin partnership is not recorded as an already announced or completed agreement.
articles.timestampEvidence: Nasdaq reproduction explicitly gives October 6, 2026 9:30 AM EDT; FinancialContent agrees.
